// diagnostic E0141

Jet.SingleUseConsumedOnOneBranch

`#SingleUse` value consumed on only one `if` branch

What

`#SingleUse` value consumed on only one `if` branch

Why

A `#SingleUse` value must be used on every path, or one path ends its scope without doing its job

Fix

Consume the `#SingleUse` value on every control-flow branch.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.SingleUseConsumedOnOneBranch: Tests/UI/single_use_branch.stderr.

Error: Jet.SingleUseConsumedOnOneBranch: `db` still owes `consume` on one path through this `if`
  --> Tests/UI/single_use_branch.jet:11:5
    |
 11 |     db: acquire("db")
    |     ^^
 Why: A `#SingleUse` value has to be used on every path — here it is consumed on one branch but not the other, so the program could reach the end of its scope without doing its job
 Fix: Use `db` exactly once on every branch: consume it in the missing arm, or move it out before the `if`
